summary:
1. Microgravity Effects: Tracks health problems caused by microgravity, radiation exposure and physical strain.
2. Mental Health: Monitors stress, sleep loss, mental fatigue and mood changes.
3. Cabin Conditions: Tracks radiation levels, air quality and temperature inside the spacecraft.
4. AI-Based System: Uses sensors and AI to collect and analyse health data and detect possible health risks.
5. Preventive Actions: Recommends rest, medical reviews, workload changes and other preventive measures.
Conclusion
ASTRA Health Monitor helps astronauts stay healthy and safe during space missions. It uses AI and real-time monitoring to detect health problems early and recommend preventive actions, even when communication with Earth is delayed.
